headline: ScreenConnect attacks breach MSPs; Maersk extortion; OpenSSH SSHole and GPUStack KEV due 11-12, Barracuda ESG 11-13

bullets.text: New: active attacks on ScreenConnect have breached managed service providers and affected dozens of organizations (BleepingComputer). With N-central zero-days also in play (6 outlets), MSP remote-access tooling is the main target this week.

New: Baker Tilly is notifying clients of a data breach at a third-party provider (BleepingComputer). WhiteArmor claims 100GB stolen from Maersk and demands $5 million; Maersk has confirmed a breach. Vanderbilt University remains on lockdown after ransomware (6 outlets).

KEV due tomorrow, 11-12: OpenSSH SSHole CVE-2026-123158 (exploited on Linux, 3 outlets), GPUStack CVE-2026-102895, FreeSwitch CVE-2026-116779, IBM Aspera Faspex CVE-2026-123218. Due 11-13: Barracuda ESG CVE-2026-116606 and CVE-2026-111560, Ivanti CVE-2026-104935.

Critical Xen Orchestra flaws are exploited (3 outlets; no CVEs in the brief); Qlik Sense servers are hit with reverse shells; Zoom Workplace CVE-2026-108186 allows unauthenticated remote privilege escalation and is patched.

Cloud and AI: Notion says a Fireworks breach exposed customer AI chat transcripts; AntiFox AI agents are used to steal AWS credentials; Microsoft reports GSocket abuse for stealthy command-and-control.

Still active: Cisco BroadWorks and Openwave exploited (KEV due 11-24). Other breaches: York University, Credit Mutuel Arkea (€100m missing), Wyndham, Fullerton Health. The week ran 1.17x the 90-day average.

actions: MSPs and their customers: patch ScreenConnect, review its access logs and sessions, and apply the N-central hotfixes.
Patch OpenSSH (CVE-2026-123158), GPUStack, FreeSwitch and IBM Aspera Faspex today; their KEV deadline is 11-12.
Barracuda ESG: apply fixes for CVE-2026-116606 and CVE-2026-111560 (due 11-13) and hunt for compromise; patch Ivanti Connect Secure and Citrix.
Keep Xen Orchestra off the internet, check Qlik Sense servers for reverse shells, and update Zoom Workplace for CVE-2026-108186.
Review AWS access keys and CloudTrail for unusual use; hunt for GSocket on Linux hosts.
Patch Cisco BroadWorks, Openwave Webtop, Outlook (CVE-2026-124194) and Chrome before 11-24; update Git on developer machines and CI.
